headline: Short-term law keeps FAA programs, airport grants, and aviation taxes running through May 10, 2024.
what_it_does: This law temporarily extends Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) programs and authority through May 10, 2024. It keeps funding in place for FAA operations, air traffic equipment, research, and airport improvement grants. It also continues the taxes on airline tickets and aviation fuel that pay into the trust fund for aviation programs. It extends other expiring programs, including drone safety programs, air service for small communities, and passenger advisory committees.

who_it_affects.how: Taxes on airline tickets continue to be collected through May 10, 2024, and advisory committees on customer service and passengers with disabilities keep operating.

who_it_affects.group: Airports and the state and local governments that run them
who_it_affects.how: They can keep receiving federal Airport Improvement Program grants for planning, construction, noise, and land use projects through May 10, 2024.

who_it_affects.group: FAA employees, including air traffic controllers
who_it_affects.how: Funding authority for FAA salaries, operations, and maintenance continues through May 10, 2024.

who_it_affects.group: Small and rural communities with limited air service
who_it_affects.how: The Essential Air Service program and the Small Community Air Service Development grant program are reauthorized through May 10, 2024.
Drone test sites, safety exemptions, and drone detection and enforcement programs continue through May 10, 2024.

who_it_affects.group: Airlines and fuel buyers in aviation
who_it_affects.how: Taxes on aviation fuel and other aviation fees continue to be collected through May 10, 2024.
A pause on certain federal safety rules for crewed launch vehicle design and operation is extended to May 11, 2024.

who_it_affects.group: Airports in the Marshall Islands, Micronesia, Palau, and Midway Island
who_it_affects.how: They remain eligible for federal airport development funding through May 10, 2024.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted March 8, 2024; extensions run through May 10, 2024 (May 11, 2024 for the commercial spaceflight rule pause).
